images.author: RCSB PDB; structure authors H. Lee and S. Hafenstein
images.why: Colour 3D fallback: the entry identifies the EV-A71 strain 11316 capsid, determined by electron microscopy at 3.04 Å. Single capsid suitable for a near-square crop. Image pixel dimensions unverified; ≥1600 px not confirmed. Licence explicitly covers structure-summary images in https://www.rcsb.org/pages/usage-policy.

images.author: RCSB PDB; structure authors A. Catching, S. Capponi and R. Andino
images.why: Colour 3D fallback: explicitly identified as Enterovirus A71 strain 4643 wild-type capsid, based on 4.20 Å electron microscopy. Single complete capsid assembly. Image pixel dimensions unverified; ≥1600 px not confirmed. Licence: https://www.rcsb.org/pages/usage-policy.

images.author: RCSB PDB; structure author K. L. Shingler
images.why: Colour 3D fallback: caption identifies the Enterovirus 71 A-particle, reconstructed using cryo-EM at 6.30 Å. Represents an expanded uncoating intermediate rather than the native virion. Image pixel dimensions unverified; ≥1600 px not confirmed. Licence: https://www.rcsb.org/pages/usage-policy.
